name: hoodfi-builder
//deps: Pinned exact, not caret-ranged, and matched to the versions the site actually builds with. A fresh caret resolve here picked up @wagmi/connectors 8.1.0, whose bundled Coinbase SDK imports @x402/* packages that nothing installs — eight module-not-found errors from a dependency this app never calls. The site is on 8.0.22 via its lockfile and builds clean; there is no reason for the two apps to be on different wallet stacks.
//overrides: All three are transitive, none is called by this app, and all three exist only to reach the Base Account connector we never surface.
